children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the area of the sector in terms of the radius $r$ and the angle $\theta$ at the centre.

spec.description: General degree-angle sector theta with radiusr, no numerical angle supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Original givens/construction only; no derived area or radius displayed.

answer.worked: The sector is $\frac{\theta}{360}$ of the full circle, whose area is $\pi r^2$. Thus $A=\frac{\theta}{360}\pi r^2$.
